benefit: All India Competitive Examination for Junior Research Fellowship/Senior Research Fellowship, for admission to Ph.D. programmes

provider: Banda University of Agriculture & Technology, Banda
benefit: Admission to undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes in agriculture, horticulture, veterinary science, technology and related fields across agricultural universities in Uttar Pradesh
B.Sc. (Agriculture) is among the professional education courses for which KEA conducts a common entrance test

provider: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB)

name_en: IBPS AFO (Agricultural Field Officer, Scale I)
eligibility_en: Age: Minimum 20 years, Maximum 30 years (as on 21.07.2026). Educational Qualification: 4 year Degree (graduation) in Agriculture/ Horticulture/Animal Husbandry/ Veterinary Science/ Dairy Science/ Fishery Science/ Pisciculture/ Agri. Marketing & Cooperation/ Co-operation & Banking/ Agro-Forestry/Forestry/ Agricultural Biotechnology/ B.Tech Biotechnology/ Food Science/ Agriculture Business Management/ Food Technology/ Dairy Technology/ Agricultural Engineering/ Sericulture/ Fisheries Engineering.
benefit: Recruitment as Agricultural Field Officer (Scale I) under the Specialist Officer cadre in Participating Public Sector Banks

provider: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
eligibility_en: Age: 21 to 30 years (as on 01.11.2025). Assistant Manager, Grade 'A' (RDBS), agriculture-relevant discipline qualifications: Agriculture Engineering — Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture Engineering with minimum 60% marks (PWBD 55%) OR Post Graduate degree with minimum 55% (PWBD 50%); Plantation & Horticulture — Bachelor's Degree in Horticulture with minimum 60% (PWBD 55%) OR PG degree with minimum 55% (PWBD 50%); Fisheries — Bachelor's Degree in Fisheries Science with 60% (ST/PWBD 55%) OR PG degree with 55% (ST/PWBD 50%); Food Processing — Bachelor's Degree in Food Processing/Food Technology/Dairy Technology with 60% (SC/PWBD 55%) OR PG degree with 55% (SC/PWBD 50%); Land Development & Soil Science — Bachelor's Degree in Soil Science/Agriculture/Environmental Science with 60% (PWBD 55%) OR PG degree with 55% (PWBD 50%).
benefit: Recruitment as Assistant Manager in Grade 'A' (Rural Development Banking Service), with agriculture-relevant discipline vacancies in Agriculture Engineering, Plantation & Horticulture, Fisheries, Food Processing and Land Development & Soil Science

name_en: MPPSC Assistant Director (Farmer Welfare & Agriculture Development, Field & Extension)

eligibility_en: Available to a student pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree programme admitted through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) in an Agricultural University located outside their State of domicile. Awardee must maintain merit and good conduct, take up studies on a whole-time basis, not accept any other scholarship, and not change the subject/University for which the NTS was awarded.
benefit: Rs. 2,000/- per month for Bachelor's (Under Graduate) students and Rs. 3,000/- per month for Master's (Post Graduate) students, disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer through the College/University

name_en: ICAR-PG Scholarship (erstwhile JRF for Master's studies)
benefit: Rs. 12,640/- per month per student (revised rate, effective Academic Session 2018-19)

name_en: ICAR-JRF/SRF Fellowship for Ph.D. Studies (including Veterinary Science)
benefit: Rs. 25,000/- per month for the 1st and 2nd years, and Rs. 28,000/- per month for the 3rd year, per student (revised rate, effective Academic Session 2018-19)

eligibility_en: For under-graduate students in Agriculture (including Agricultural Engineering & Home Science) and Animal Science subjects. Awarded strictly on merit-cum-means: candidates must satisfy the Means Test and have secured not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade points in aggregate in the qualifying examination (65% if the qualifying examination was more than 1 year but not more than 5 years before the year of award). Limited to not more than 7.5% of actual admissions to the Bachelor degree course at each approved college. Admissible to persons of Indian nationality or persons domiciled in India, irrespective of sex, race or religion.
benefit: Rs. 1,000/- per month per student (revised rate, effective Academic Session 2018-19)

name_en: ICAR Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
eligibility_en: Exclusively for students belonging to Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe communities as defined by the Government of India, admitted to undergraduate degree programmes of Agriculture & Allied Sciences at Agricultural Universities (e.g. B.Sc.(Agri.), B.V.Sc., B.Sc.(Agril. Engg.), B.Sc.(Home Science), B.F.Sc., B.Sc.(Forestry)). The scheme provides for the award of 240 scholarships every year, earmarked to individual Agricultural Universities in proportion to actual SC/ST admissions.
benefit: Original guideline rate: Rs. 300/- per month plus a contingent grant of Rs. 750/- per annum (for tuition fee, books, uniform etc.). Revised rate, effective Academic Session 2018-19: Rs. 1,000/- per month per student.

name_en: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
eligibility_en: The girl candidate should be admitted to the First year of a Degree level course, or the Second year of a Degree level course through lateral entry, in any AICTE-approved Institution. Maximum two girl children per family are eligible. Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year, supported by a valid income certificate issued by the State/UT Government. Selection is on the basis of merit in the qualifying (10+2/equivalent) examination; the gap between passing the qualifying examination and admission should not be more than two years.
benefit: Rs. 50,000/- per annum for every year of study (maximum 4 years for first-year admits, maximum 3 years for lateral-entry second-year admits) as a lump sum towards college fee, computer, stationery, books, equipment, software, etc.; paid via Direct Benefit Transfer. 5,000 scholarships are earmarked per annum, state/UT-wise as per the scheme's Annexure A.
English-language proficiency test described as "the world's most trusted English test"; used for study, work and migration applications abroad
Measures listening, speaking, reading and writing "in the way they're actually used in classrooms, lectures and coursework"; recognized by 13,000+ institutions across 160+ countries

Accepted by 20,000+ graduate, business, and law programs worldwide; measures verbal reasoning, quantitative reasoning, critical thinking and analytical writing. Fee: $220 worldwide ($231.30 in China), including sending scores to up to 4 programs. Scores are valid for 5 years; the test may be taken once every 21 days, up to 5 times in any 12-month period.

provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
eligibility_en: Applicant must be a citizen of, or a refugee permanently resident in, an eligible Commonwealth country (India is an eligible country); must hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard; must be unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship. Scholarships are awarded under the CSC's development themes, which have funded agriculture- and food-systems-related research.
benefit: Monthly stipend of £1,712 (£2,000 for universities in the London metropolitan area), plus tuition fees, approved airfare, study travel grants, and child allowance where applicable

name_en: DAAD / IAESTE Scholarships for Agriculture and Forestry
eligibility_en: For students pursuing graduation, post-graduation and PhD in the fields of natural sciences, engineering, agriculture and forestry (IAESTE).
benefit: Funding for a placement of 2 to 12 months in Germany

eligibility_en: There is no age limit for candidates. Candidates who have passed the class 12/equivalent examination, or are appearing in 2026, can appear in the CUET (UG) - 2026 examination; candidates will be required to fulfil the age criteria (if any) of the University/Institution/Organization in which they are desirous of taking admission. 'Agriculture' (subject code 302) is offered as one of the Domain Subjects a candidate may choose, up to a maximum of five subjects including languages and the General Aptitude Test.
benefit: Common University Entrance Test (UG), conducted in 13 mediums across India and abroad, for admission into Undergraduate Programmes at all Central Universities and State/Participating Universities in India for the academic year 2026-27

name_en: PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
eligibility_en: Open to Indian nationals belonging to OBCs, EBCs and DNTs (as notified by the Central Govt./State Govt./UT Admin.) who have passed the Matriculation or Higher Secondary or any higher examination and are studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage. Employed students whose income combined with their parents'/guardians' income, and unemployed students whose parents'/guardians' income from all sources, does not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum are eligible. 'Group 1: Degree and Post Graduate level professional courses' — which carries the highest scholarship component — explicitly includes 'Professional courses in Medicine, Engineering, Technology, Planning, Architecture, Design, Fashion Technology, Agriculture, Veterinary & Allied Sciences, Management, Business Finance/Administration, Computer Science/ Applications' as well as M.Phil., Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral programmes of Group 1, Group 2 and Group 3 courses.
benefit: For Group 1 courses (which include Agriculture and Veterinary & Allied Sciences): Academic Allowance of Rs. 10,000/- plus Tuition Fee of Rs. 10,000/-, totalling Rs. 20,000/- per year, for the complete duration of the course; paid as a Freeship Card (no pre-payment of tuition/hostel fees) with amounts released via DBT.
